ModInfo.Name: FF8 Steam Deck Button Glyphs
ModInfo.Author: todi
ModInfo.Description:
Shows the Steam Deck / Steam Controller face buttons (A, B, X, Y, L1/R1, L2/R2, View, Menu) wherever FF8 names a button, instead of "B1", "B2", ...
Requires the English Steam 2013 version of FF8 with FFNx (as installed by Junction VIII). Turns on FFNx's ff8_use_gamepad_icons.
Timber train mission: the keypad diamond in Rinoa's explanation follows the Deck's layout (Y top, X left, B right, A bottom); each code number moves to the button its command is bound to (deckglyphs.dll, log in deckglyphs.log in the game folder).
With AxlRose's WIP (UI on): both mods ship menu/hires/iconfl01_04.dds and iconfl03_04.dds. Place this mod ABOVE AxlRose's in the Junction VIII list so the Deck glyphs win.
ModInfo.ReleaseNotes: 0.7: all art on the two icon pages is our own (menu pointer, D-pad, star and others redrawn); built from source by GitHub Actions. 0.6: View and Menu as a pill with the symbol only. 0.5: back to our own grey glyphs with rim. 0.4: Valve's official Steam Deck glyphs (local build, not for release yet). 0.3: icon textures as DDS, so J8 load order decides against other UI mods. 0.2: train mission keypad diamond follows the hardware layout. 0.1: Deck glyphs for the button icons.
